The recommended starting dose is 2 mg. Because the effect of Zanaflex peaks at approximately 1 to 2 hours post-dose and dissipates between 3 to 6 hours post-dose, treatment can be repeated at 6 to 8 hour intervals, as needed, to a maximum of three doses in 24 hours.

dose.frequency: every 6 to 8 hours as needed (max 3 doses in 24 hours)

regimens.dose_text: Start 2 mg PO repeated at 6 to 8 hour intervals as needed (max 3 doses in 24 hours). Gradually increase by 2 to 4 mg per dose every 1 to 4 days until satisfactory tone reduction; total daily dose must not exceed 36 mg (single doses >16 mg not studied). Maintain consistent tablet/capsule formulation and fed/fasted state. Taper slowly (2-4 mg/day) when discontinuing high/prolonged doses.

regimens.dose_text: In renal insufficiency (CrCl < 25 mL/min), clearance is reduced by >50%. Reduce individual doses during titration; if higher doses are required, increase individual doses rather than dosing frequency. Monitor closely for dry mouth, somnolence, asthenia, and dizziness.
